title: Data Leakage
description: The student may inadvertently share sensitive information (e.g., personal identification details) when submitting the assignment, leading to potential data leakage.

title: Data Misuse
description: The Grades Portal Web App may misuse the submitted assignment data (e.g., using it for purposes other than grading), leading to privacy violations.

title: Identifier Exposure
description: The submission and grading requests contain unique identifiers (student id) that can be linked back to the individual, potentially exposing their identity.

title: Processing of Identified Data
description: The assignment & grading service processes identified data (student id, course) which could lead to unauthorized access or misuse of personal information.

title: Non-repudiation Threat
description: The data flow includes identifiable information that may prevent individuals from denying their involvement in submissions or grading, leading to potential privacy concerns.

title: Unintended Data Exposure
description: The grading service may unintentionally expose sensitive student information (e.g., student ID, course details) when storing the assignment file, especially if proper access controls are not implemented.

title: Data Disclosure upon Retrieval
description: When the assignment store retrieves and processes the stored assignment files, there is a risk of disclosing personal data (student ID, course, submission time) to unauthorized users or systems.

title: Identifying Data Processing
description: The teacher logs in and requests the queue of submissions, which may involve processing identifiable data of students, leading to potential identification of individuals without proper safeguards.

title: Identifying Data Processing at Destination
description: The Grades Portal Web App processes the identified data received from the teacher, which could lead to unauthorized identification or linking of students' submissions.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The portal may not have sufficient access controls to ensure that only authorized teachers can view student submissions, leading to potential unauthorized access to sensitive student information.

title: Insecure Data Handling
description: The teacher may mishandle the data received from the portal, such as sharing it with unauthorized individuals or storing it insecurely, leading to potential data leaks.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The teacher may retain student submission data longer than necessary, violating data retention policies and increasing the risk of data exposure.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The teacher may not have obtained explicit consent from the student to record and share their grades and feedback, leading to a lack of transparency and potential violation of privacy rights.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store grades and feedback insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Misuse
description: The Grades Portal Web App may misuse the recorded grades and feedback, such as using them for purposes other than intended, which could harm the student's privacy.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The grading service may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to write grade records.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The grade records database may store sensitive information without proper encryption, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The grade records may be retained longer than necessary, leading to potential misuse or unauthorized access to historical data.

title: Identifying Data Processing
description: The system processes identified data when the student requests their own grades and feedback, which could lead to the exposure of personal information if not handled properly.

title: Data Misuse by the Grades Portal
description: The Grades Portal Web App may misuse the data received from the student, such as sharing it with unauthorized parties or using it for purposes other than intended.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The portal may not have sufficient access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to view grades and feedback meant for other students.

title: Data Retention and Disposal Issues
description: The student may not be aware of how long their grades and feedback are stored and whether they are properly disposed of after a certain period, leading to potential unauthorized access in the future.

title: Legitimate Access to Sensitive Data
description: The parent, as an external entity, has legitimate access to their child's grades, which could lead to potential misuse if the parent's account is compromised or if they share their login credentials with unauthorized individuals.

title: Insecure Data Handling
description: The Grades Portal Web App may inadvertently expose sensitive information about the child if proper security measures are not in place during the processing of the request for grades.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The Grades Portal Web App may retain sensitive data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Unauthorized Access to Grades
description: The portal may inadvertently allow unauthorized access to a parent's child's grades if proper authentication and authorization mechanisms are not in place.

title: Data Misuse by Parent
description: The parent may misuse the accessed grades and feedback, potentially leading to negative consequences for the child, such as undue pressure or emotional distress.

title: Legitimate Access to Sensitive Data
description: The school administrator may inadvertently share sensitive data (e.g., parent-child relationships, emails) with unauthorized parties due to misconfiguration or lack of awareness of data sharing policies.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store sensitive data insecurely, leading to potential unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Misuse by the Application
description: The Grades Portal Web App may misuse the data it receives from the administrator, such as using it for purposes other than intended (e.g., marketing).

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The grading service may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to write account records and parent-child relationship links to the account directory.

title: Inadequate Data Integrity Checks
description: The account directory may not implement sufficient integrity checks, leading to the possibility of incorrect or malicious data being stored, affecting the reliability of account records and relationships.

title: Data Disclosure Risk
description: The account directory may expose sensitive account information if not properly secured, leading to potential unauthorized access to personal data.

title: Data Disclosure during Transfer
description: The assignment and grading service transfers full grade records, assignments, and account directory to the cloud hosting provider, which may lead to unintended data disclosure if the data is intercepted during transmission or if the cloud provider mishandles the data.

title: Data Disclosure at Destination
description: The cloud hosting provider may store or process the received data in a way that could lead to unauthorized access or data breaches, resulting in the disclosure of sensitive information such as student grades and personal account details.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The Grade Records Database may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to access sensitive grade records.

title: Insecure Data Handling
description: The Assignment & Grading Service may mishandle the retrieved grade records, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information to unauthorized parties.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Assignment & Grading Service may retain grade records longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.
